cards.text: Right before this, the LORD called out the city for dishonest scales, violence and lies (Micah 6:11-12). Now the prophet Micah speaks for himself, and he opens with "Woe is me!" He says he's like someone gathering summer fruit at the gleaning of the vineyard, after the harvest is done.

cards.question: Micah goes looking through the vineyard after the harvest. What does he find?

answers.text: More fruit than he can carry

cards.text: Not one cluster. That's reaching into a cookie box with your whole heart and pulling out CRUMBS. Then Micah says it plain: "The godly man has perished from the earth; there is no one upright among men."

cards.question: With no one upright left among men, what does Micah see people doing to each other?

answers.text: Hunting one another with a net
Sharing their harvest with the poor
Rebuilding the walls of the city

cards.question: Micah says only a few of the people lie in wait for blood.

cards.text: And they're not beginners. Micah says both hands are skilled at evil. BOTH, friend, and I've got a whole mustache that still can't tie a bow on a cookie box.

cards.question: Even the leaders are in on it. Micah says the prince and the judge demand a ___.
Micah says that when the powerful one speaks his evil desire, they all conspire together.

cards.text: Then Micah has a picture for even the best of these people, and I promise you, you won't want to hug it.

cards.question: Micah says even the best of these people is like what?

cards.text: The most upright one is sharper than a hedge of thorns, and that's the BEST one. Then Micah speaks of the day for your watchmen, the day of your visitation.

cards.question: Micah says the day of the visitation is still a long way off.

cards.text: Now is the time of their confusion, he says, and then: "Do not rely on a friend; do not trust in a companion." Not your buddy, not your neighbor, not the guy who's been in the group chat since day one!

cards.question: Micah goes even closer than friends. Who does he say to seal the doors of your mouth from?

answers.text: The one who lies in your arms

cards.text: Then he says why: a son dishonors his father, a daughter rises against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.

cards.question: Micah sums it up: a man's enemies are the members of his own ___.

cards.text: Leaders, friends, family: Micah can't lean on any of them. Then comes the turn: "But as for me…"

cards.question: With no one around him to lean on, what does Micah say he will do?

answers.text: Look to the LORD and wait

cards.question: Micah ends sure that his God will hear him.

cards.text: "My God will hear me." Friend, I know a little about waiting in the dark, and that's the line you hold onto.
